organizations.normalization_notes: Canonical bucket for documented self-employment when no separate employing organization is supported. Person-specific wording and locations remain on affiliations.
The institution is recorded as an educational affiliation. Virginia Rathbun Stuart's relationship was student status, not employment.

affiliations.date_precision: The Dartmouth authority record says Rapf became a freelance Hollywood screenwriter after graduating in 1935, then served as a wartime federal screenwriter; it does not date the transition or OSS connection.
affiliations.research_notes: The distinctive indexed name and middle initial probably match Maurice Harry Rapf, but the reviewed institutional source does not directly bridge him to the OSS index. This is earlier documented self-employment, not an asserted immediate predecessor role.

affiliations.date_precision: Skidmore says Rathbun Stuart graduated in 1943 and joined OSS in November, just months after graduation; it does not give the graduation date or exclude every possible short intervening activity.
affiliations.research_notes: Student status immediately preceded OSS within months. Skidmore is not classified as an employer, and no last civilian employer is inferred.

claims.claim_text: Maurice Harry Rapf worked as a freelance screenwriter in Hollywood after graduating from Dartmouth in 1935.
claims.evidence_excerpt: After graduating, he became a freelance screenwriter in Hollywood
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Dartmouth documents Rapf's freelance Hollywood screenwriting after his 1935 graduation and before or during the wartime period.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable match to the indexed Maurice H Rapf; the institutional biography does not directly cite OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar self-employment, but neither the ending date nor immediacy before OSS is established.
claims.match_notes: The profile visibly qualifies both identity and temporal limits. No studio employer is inferred from freelance work.

claims.claim_text: Official and institutional sources confirm that indexed Virginia Rathbun is Virginia Rathbun Stuart, a 1943 Skidmore graduate who served in OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: An official 1944 caption names Virginia Rathbun among OSS personnel, while Skidmore identifies the same woman by her later surname and 1943 class year.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact official OSS caption and a strong institutional account using both her indexed and married names.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records place her in OSS by November 1943 and on an overseas journey in July 1944.
claims.match_notes: The index name, official caption, Providence association, Skidmore class year, and later full name align. The later surname is published as a documented variant.

claims.claim_text: Virginia Rathbun Stuart was a Skidmore College student shortly before joining OSS in November 1943.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Just months after graduation, Virginia Rathbun Stuart '43 joined the Office of Strategic Services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Skidmore places graduation and OSS entry only months apart in 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the paired official OSS caption and institutional alumni account.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded immediate-pre-OSS status: 1943 graduation followed by November 1943 OSS entry.
claims.match_notes: Skidmore is recorded as a student affiliation, not an employer; no civilian employer is inferred.
